summary: Reviewed sends and drafts accept up to 10 attachments under a 5 MiB combined cap, a forward can carry the selected message's attachments bound to its historyId, and GET /attachment?opaque=1 returns an exact byte copy of any attachment type under the cap.

contract.policy: capabilities.attachmentPolicy {mimeTypes, maximumBytes 5 MiB per file, maximumOutgoing 10, maximumTotalBytes 5 MiB}; local attachments keep the PDF/PNG/JPEG/WebP/UTF-8 TXT content checks; names must be unique case-insensitively
contract.forward: proposal.forwardAttachments {messageId, historyId, partIds[1..10]} valid only for mode forward; read scope; GET /messages/{id}?format=full must match id and historyId else 409; each part is fetched and size-checked; review adds forwardSource {messageId,historyId} and forwardedAttachments [{partId,name,mimeType,size,sha256}] only when present, so existing review digests are unchanged; dispatch re-reviews and any byte or history change alters the digest (409)
contract.opaque: GET /inbox-v1/attachment?...&opaque=1 -> {version:1, opaque:true, messageId, partId, historyId, name, mimeType (type/subtype token or application/octet-stream), dataBase64, size, sha256}; any type <= 5 MiB, bound to message, part and historyId; intended for a client-side Save to Files only
contract.capabilities: forwardAttachments and opaqueAttachments = read scope; older servers omit them
